title: chair cover
text: chair cover. I recently purchased a new lift chair and it is smaller.  I ordered this cover because it offered the smaller size.  Fits perfectly.  Easy to install.  One strap.  The arm covers migrate a bit - but thats to be expected.  I wish there was a more taupe color to better match my chair, but it's protected.  FYI... these cover is NOT waterproof or even resistant.  It's simply a quilted cotton cloth. Should wash and dry fairly well.  I imagine it won't last for more than a couple years with careful care.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
